notes.title: Cardfight!! Vanguard Dear Days DLC for Booster Pack 06 and Trial Deck 01~03 now
notes.notes:
New information hot off the press for Cardfight!! Vanguard Dear Days! 

New DLC now on sale!
The DLC featuring characters featured in the animation, Cardfight!! Vanguard will+Dress Season 2, Urara Haneyama and Raika Koshiba and Booster Pack 06 and more is now on sale! Furthermore, Trial Deck 01: Urara Haneyama -Bandmaster of Blossoming Bonds-, Trial Deck 02: Michiru Hazama -Demonic Jewel Dragon of the Four Flames- and Trial Deck 03: Raika Koshiba -Skyfall Executors- will be available in a free update!

On top of these, the Character Set which contains character sleeves as well as Card Expansion Vol. 1 Blazing Dragon Reborn will be available as well! 

Calling for Original Design Proposals!
Currently ongoing as part of a fan participation project is the original sleeve design proposal for Cardfight!! Vanguard Dear Days!
The theme is "Vanguard Dear Days in Spring" and the chosen design will be implemented in game as an illustrated sleeve and given to all players!

Entry proposals till February 26th 06:59 PST!
For more details, do check the application form! ( https://form.bushiroad.com/form/vgdd_spring )

Higher and Stronger!
Let's enjoy a heated cardfight!
